summary: Eps 25-62 stitch three seasons: S3 (110355, our 25-36) adapts vols 15-20, chs 140-200 (+a 2-page teaser of 201), but skips the Hokkaido-side Sekiya arc 171-175 and only skims 191-200 in its finale montage; S4 (142343, our 37-49) opens by backfilling those gaps (171-176 in eps 37-38, 191-200 in eps 39-40) and then runs linearly 204-243 (+244 excerpt); the Final Season (166521, our 50-62) runs linearly 244-302 at ~4-5 chapters per episode. Its finale stops on the last page of vol 30 (ch 302 'Mayhem on the Train') - the manga's last 12 chapters (303-314) are reserved for the announced 'Saishuushou - Bousou Ressha-hen' (AniList 210073, winter 2026/27), so the ASK's 'finishes the manga at 314' is wrong. Per-episode data for S3/S4 comes from the fandom wiki's page-level 'Adapted Chapters' lists, corroborated by programming-cafe's independent Japanese correspondence table, Wikipedia season spans/summaries and chapter-title matches; the Final Season (no fandom pages) rests on programming-cafe plus MAL manga-reader posts, episode titles that equal chapter titles, and multiple sources for the 244 start / 302 end. Five OVAs carry TV-skipped canon (55-59+32; 83-85+104; 63-69; 108-113; 102,104-107,228), and the 2025 'Sapporo Beer Koujou-hen' films are a duplicate of eps 50-55, not extra canon.

The manga's 303-314 are NOT adapted yet - 'Bousou Ressha-hen' (AniList 210073) announced 2026-03-30 for winter 2026/27.

structure.notes: Confirmed components (AniList GraphQL): S1 99699 (12 eps, 2018-04-09..06-25) = our 1-12; S2 102977 (12, 2018-10-08..12-24) = 13-24; S3 110355 'Golden Kamuy 3rd Season' (12 eps, 2020-10-05..12-21) = our 25-36; S4 142343 '4th Season' (13 eps, 2022-10-03..2023-06-26; eps 37-42 aired 2022-10-03..11-07, broadcast paused after a staff death, re-run from ep37 on 2023-04-03, eps 43-49 aired 2023-05-15..06-26) = our 37-49; Final Season 166521 'Golden Kamuy: Saishuushou' (13 eps, 2026-01-05..03-30) = our 50-62. Cumulative numbering 1-62 matches Wikipedia's overall numbering exactly (titles 'To Karafuto' ... 'Daughter of Wilk'). Chapter spans: S3 = 140-200 (+201 p.1-2 teaser; skips 171-175, skims 191-200), S4 = 171-176 backfill + 191-200 backfill + 201-243 (+244 p.4-8), S5 = 244-302. The Final Season does NOT finish the manga: it ends on the last page of vol 30 (ch 302); the remaining 303-314 (vol 31) are assigned to 'Golden Kamuy: Saishuushou - Bousou Ressha-hen' (AniList 210073, MAL 63850, NOT_YET_RELEASED, announced 2026-03-30 by the production for 'this winter' = winter 2026/27). So after the stitch: aired/total episodes 62 with a sequel pending, max_adapted_chapter 302, continue_from_chapter 303, anime status still not complete. Entry-level max_adapted must NOT be 314 (the ASK/flag #856 wording is wrong on this point). 196115 'Golden Kamuy: Sapporo Beer Koujou-hen' (MOVIE, 2 parts, 2025-10-10 and 2025-10-31, 66-68 min each) is the theatrical advance version of Final Season eps 50-55 ('第五十話～第五十五話までが上映 ... 内容は同じ' per a Yahoo Chiebukuro best answer; official site: '最終章の序章で構成された', '放送に先駆け') - an ALTERNATIVE/duplicate, not order-only canon; exclude from the watch order or mark as a duplicate of 50-55. 106506 'Golden Douga Gekijou' (ONA, 46 shorts) and 154125 (its specials) adapt omake gags only - exclude. Five OVAs carry TV-skipped canon (order_only below); all are bundled with manga volumes/the novel, and community watch order (ani-vista, animefreakjapan) is S1 -> OVA1 -> S2 -> OVA2 -> OVA3 -> (OVA4) -> S3 -> S4 -> (OVA5) -> Final Season.

flags_for_sean: ASK/flag #856 correction: the Final Season (166521, our 50-62) does NOT finish the manga - it ends on ch 302 (last page of vol 30); chs 303-314 go to 'Golden Kamuy: Saishuushou - Bousou Ressha-hen' (AniList 210073, NOT_YET_RELEASED, announced 2026-03-30 for winter 2026/27). Set max_adapted 302 / continue_from 303, and keep the anime status open. Also S4 is not '~201-273': it is 171-176 + 191-200 backfill plus 201-243 (+244 excerpt); S5 = 244-302.
